newsitem.title: GERMANY: Wedgwood in talks to buy Rosenthal - magazine.
newsitem.headline: Wedgwood in talks to buy Rosenthal - magazine.

text.p: Anglo-Irish tableware maker Waterford Wedgwood Plc plans to acquire German rival Rosenthal AG, German news magazine Focus reported.

The two have been talks for several months and the main obstacle to the transaction is a limit on voting rights at Rosenthal which prevents individual shareholders owning more than five percent of the voting capital, Focus said in a Sunday advance copy of a report to be published in Monday's editions. Rosenthal last week announced it made a loss of 10.7 million marks in the first half of 1996 after a loss of 13.1 million marks in the year-earlier period.
Its sales fell to 151.5 million marks from 165.1 million.
